chunks: The day you see the believers, men and women, with their light advancing ahead and to the right of them, (it will be said to them:) 'Good news for you this day, of gardens with rivers flowing beneath them, abiding eternally therein. That is the great attainment.'

key_terms.بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ: ahead and to the right of them

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the light of believers on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'light' (nur) is often interpreted as the cumulative effect of faith and good deeds, with its position ahead and to the right symbolizing guidance and divine favor. This verse highlights the collective salvation of both men and women, emphasizing that spiritual radiance is the primary marker of success in the Hereafter, culminating in the eternal bliss of Jannah.
